entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A shamanic human planeswalker from Skalla, sole survivor of her plane, who wields the Arkbow and seeks to protect nature.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Vivien's homeworld, destroyed by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Smaragdi
entities.description: A tribe of rangers and druids on Skalla sworn to protect the forest, including Vivien.

entities.name: Nura
entities.description: An advanced civilization on Skalla that encircled the dwindling woodlands.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who destroyed Skalla and trapped Vivien on Ravnica.

entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: An artifact containing an invocation of every creature that ever lived on Skalla, used by Vivien to call spirit creatures.

entities.name: Baron of Vernot
entities.description: A noble of Luneau who tortured Vivien and was killed by her.

entities.name: Luneau
entities.description: A city on Ixalan with a Royal Menagerie, destroyed by Vivien.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker Vivien tried to assassinate and later considered a threat.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who recommended splitting into teams.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker on the assassination team.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who warped time around Liliana.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A fighter who insisted with Vivien that surrender was not an option.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers Vivien helps against Bolas and the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A Coppercoat bonder who gains control of monsters via the Ozolith, ignites, and is later compleated.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A crystal formation that caused bondings, mutations and monster attacks; Lukka overloaded it.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: A leader who took control of Drannith's defenses.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who claimed to work for Urabrask and led Vivien to him.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The wounded red-aligned praetor who plans to fight Elesh Norn and needs Halo and Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker feared by Norn whom Vivien rescues at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor Urabrask plans to oppose.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The Adversary who activated his agents at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Elspeth's companion rescued at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: An apex monster who ripped Lukka from his flesh-titan.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane of monsters where the Ozolith events occur.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane that is lifeless except for its metropolis.

events.summary: Bolas destroys Skalla; the Nura and Smaragdi make the Arkbow, but as the forest burns Vivien's spark ignites and she planeswalks away with it.
events.quote: Vivien's spark ignited , planeswalking her and the Arkbow to safety.

events.summary: On Ixalan, Vivien intervenes against the Baron of Vernot, is captured and tortured, escapes, kills the Baron, and frees and enlarges the menagerie, destroying Luneau.
events.quote: Vivien killed the Baron by firing the spirit of the monstrosaur at him.

events.summary: Vivien is lured to Ravnica and trapped there by the Immortal Sun, hoping to kill Bolas for Skalla's destruction.
events.quote: Seeking revenge for Skalla's destruction, she hoped to personally kill Bolas.

events.summary: Vivien and Samut insist surrender to Bolas is not an option.
events.quote: Vivien and Samut insisted that surrender was not an option

events.summary: Vivien, Jace, Jaya and Teferi nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas saves her by destroying the buildings.
events.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on.

events.summary: Vivien stays on Ravnica to help the Gatewatch after the Immortal Sun is disabled and survives the battle.
events.quote: She survived the battle and was present during the Planewide Celebration that followed.

events.summary: On Ikoria Vivien finds the bonded Lukka and learns the Ozolith is the source of the monster attacks.
events.quote: Upon further investigation, a big crystal formation called the Ozolith turned out to be the source

events.summary: Lukka takes control of the bonders' monsters and Vivien flees with the bonders.
events.quote: Vivien tried to fight him but had to flee with the bonders while Lukka went mad with power.

events.summary: Vivien and the bonders join Jirina's defense of Drannith; Lukka overloads the Ozolith, igniting his spark, and planeswalks away.
events.quote: This caused his planeswalker's spark to ignite , and he planeswalked away.

events.summary: On New Capenna Vivien meets Tezzeret and then the wounded Urabrask, who tasks her with meeting Elspeth at the Crescendo.
events.quote: who tasked her with meeting Elspeth at the Crescendo .

events.summary: At the Crescendo, Vivien rescues Elspeth and Giada during the Adversary's attack.
events.quote: Vivien arrived at the venue in time to rescue Elspeth and her companion Giada

events.summary: Vivien and Elspeth learn the plane's history from Xander's archives and planeswalk to Dominaria to inform the Gatewatch.
events.quote: the pair planeswalked to Dominaria to inform the Gatewatch of their findings.

events.summary: During the invasion Vivien helps defend Ikoria; Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Vivien finishes him with three spectral arrows.
events.quote: She finished the apex monster's work, planting three spectral arrows in Lukka's chest.
